description: Player 1's five-card library for R315's fatigue. The handicap is a human's in everything but deckSize (R180, R184: a 5-card deck is legal only for a seat whose handicap says 5), so the four opening cards (R1156000) and the turn-1 draw empty the library, whatever the seed, and the next draw is the Nth draw from an empty library (SPEC 2.4): player-turn 3's draw is fatigue 1, taken on seat 2's device because seat 2's end-turn started the turn. #5 Stockpile (1 mana, draw 2) is the card that makes seat 1 fatigue on its own device: two draws, fatigue 2 then fatigue 3, one play. It also keeps turn 1 from ending by itself (R82: a playable 1-cost card is a legal action). The other four cost 4 or more, so on 1 or 2 mana nothing but Stockpile can be played and nothing else can resolve: #17 Flood, #25 4-mana 7/7, #29 GIGA Glowy Jelly Bean and #66 The Rock have no Cast-on-draw, no Quickdraw and no hand trigger. The Rock joined the deck when the opening draw grew from three to four, so the library still lasts exactly to the turn-1 draw; it also needs a Tribute 1, which seat 1's empty board cannot pay. Seat 2 plays 08-do-nothing-b and holds The Coin, a 0-cost play, so its turn 2 never ends by itself either.
